output.reason: [ev-a93bb3b1d26d] only shows that in 0.16.0 v1beta1 is no longer the storage version (storage: true → false). Per the validator on [ev-9889c9b8706d]/[ev-e08924afdc47], v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret is still an API version in both releases. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated as part of this upgrade. The storage migration only matters before some later release that may remove v1beta1, and no evidence says that removal is scheduled. Calling it migration-required overstates the mandatory work, so the consequence should be a review-class behavior-change.

correction.statement: In 0.16.0 the clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD switches its storage version from v1beta1 to v1. v1beta1 is still served, so existing objects keep working but stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. This is a review item, not mandatory work in this release.

consequence.statement: Existing and newly written ClusterExternalSecret objects keep working. New writes are stored as v1, while existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and status.storedVersions keeps listing v1beta1. Nothing fails in this release.
consequence.remediation: Optionally run a storage version migration: rewrite all ClusterExternalSecret objects so they are stored as v1, then remove v1beta1 from the CRD's status.storedVersions. Do this before upgrading to any later release that stops serving v1beta1.
